fomod.Name: CHIM Vampire Bridge
fomod.Author: SaurOff
fomod.Description: Vampires for CHIM AI agents: they drink blood (blood thirst) and can pass on vampirism with the bite, Vampire Lords turn you into a Vampire Lord the way Dawnguard does, and the Vampire Lords and the Volkihar court bind thralls who obey them and you in everything - enemies too, taken alive. You get the lesser power Vampire's Thrall once you are a Vampire Lord. Works on its own and together with CHIM OStim Bridge (thralls in scenes) and CHIM ORomance Bridge. Configured in the MCM.
